# UX & Privacy Requirements Checklist: Calendar Settings UI

**Purpose**: Validate that Feature 063 requirements are complete, clear, measurable, and safe for the calendar settings UX/privacy scope before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-06-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. It tests requirement quality, not implementation behavior.

**Review Result**: 2026-06-27. Deep requirements review completed: 40/40 passed after follow-up requirement refinements for safe labels, unsafe provider text, and manual sync feedback timing.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are web cabinet and embedded macOS cabinet entry-point requirements both defined with the same settings hierarchy and user-facing labels? [Completeness, Spec §US1, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK002 Are first-screen requirements complete enough to prevent a placeholder or marketing-style page from satisfying the spec? [Completeness, Spec §US1, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK003 Are supported provider requirements documented as both provider families and user-facing labels, including connection method category and limitation copy? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Spec §Provider Requirements]
- [x] CHK004 Are source state requirements documented for every expected state: not connected, connecting, connected, needs action, stale, error, disabled by policy, disconnecting, disconnected, and syncing? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK005 Are calendar selection requirements complete for zero selected calendars, duplicate display names, shared/delegated calendars, private calendars, unavailable calendars, and selected counts? [Completeness, Spec §US4, Spec §FR-012, Spec §FR-043]
- [x] CHK006 Are prompt behavior requirements complete for one-minute join prompts, at-start recording prompts, disabled prompts, local upcoming display, and future auto-record copy? [Completeness, Spec §US7, Spec §FR-019, Spec §FR-020, Spec §FR-023]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is the read-only boundary stated in user terms that distinguish reading selected future calendar events from writing events, sending messages, granting access, or starting automatic recording? [Clarity, Spec §US2, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-022]
- [x] CHK008 Is the desktop credential boundary unambiguous about server-owned credentials and the desktop app not storing provider credentials? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, Plan §Constraints]
- [x] CHK009 Are safe account labels, safe event summaries, and private/free-busy minimum display rules defined without relying on vague privacy language? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, Spec §FR-024, Spec §FR-034, Spec §FR-048]
  - Resolution: safe account/source labels now require nickname, provider display name, domain-only label, masked account identifier, or generic redaction; full emails, raw IDs, URLs, tokens, passcodes, and signed/private links are forbidden.
- [x] CHK010 Is stale sync defined with an objective threshold and a clear rule for failed latest sync attempts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-046, Spec §FR-047]
- [x] CHK011 Are overlapping event rules clear for full overlap, partial overlap, duplicate events, and already-active recording context? [Clarity, Spec §FR-038, Spec §FR-041, Spec §FR-044, Spec §SC-016]
- [x] CHK012 Is the "do not ask again and record automatically" option clearly specified as unavailable or future-only in 063? [Clarity, Spec §FR-023]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK013 Are provider naming requirements consistent between the provider catalog, user-facing labels, contracts, and success criteria? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Spec §Provider Requirements, Contract §Provider List]
- [x] CHK014 Are manual recording requirements consistent across navigation, prompts, sync states, policy constraints, and embedded macOS unavailable states? [Consistency, Spec §FR-021, Spec §FR-027, Spec §FR-040, Plan §Governance]
- [x] CHK015 Are disconnect requirements consistent about stopping future sync, removing or revoking credentials where controlled, and not promising universal deletion? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016, Spec §FR-017, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK016 Are no-retrospective-matching requirements consistent across calendar selection, prompt context, overlap handling, and out-of-scope boundaries? [Consistency, Spec §FR-022, Spec §FR-029]
- [x] CHK017 Are event-category defaults consistent with preview, prompt eligibility, and private/free-busy protection requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-031, Spec §FR-032, Spec §FR-033, Spec §FR-045]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK018 Can the 30-second navigation outcome be measured for both web cabinet and embedded macOS cabinet without extra interpretation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK019 Can the 3-minute connection and calendar-selection outcome be measured with valid provider access and explicit selected-calendar state? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK020 Can the 90% read-only understanding outcome be measured with required correct answers, not inferred from clicks or completion alone? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, Measurement §Safe Understanding Confirmation]
- [x] CHK021 Can the prompt/manual-recording understanding outcome be measured separately from general read-only understanding? [Measurability, Spec §SC-014]
- [x] CHK022 Are privacy review success criteria objective enough to identify forbidden secrets, private text, signed links, passcodes, raw payloads, and committed evidence leaks? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-012]
- [x] CHK023 Are accessibility success criteria specific enough to cover provider selection, calendar selection, manual sync, prompt settings, preview, and disconnect? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-011]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK024 Are primary flows covered from finding settings through connection, calendar selection, sync health, prompt control, preview, and disconnect? [Coverage, Spec §US1-US9]
- [x] CHK025 Are alternate connection flows covered for app password/account credential, manual CalDAV URL, and provider-specific/admin-limited routes? [Coverage, Spec §US3, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK026 Are recovery flows specified for cancelled connection, denied authorization, expired credentials, provider policy block, provider downtime, no readable calendars, and partial disconnect? [Coverage, Spec §FR-030, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK027 Are policy-constrained flows specified so controls remain readable and do not look broken when workspace policy overrides local preference? [Coverage, Spec §FR-039]
- [x] CHK028 Are embedded macOS failure flows specified so unavailable/auth states do not hide native active-recording truth or one-action Stop? [Coverage, Spec §US10, Embedded Contract §Unavailable States]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK029 Are requirements defined for malicious or sensitive provider labels and event titles containing URLs, emails, passcode-like strings, token-looking strings, or private customer names? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-049]
  - Resolution: provider names, calendar labels, and event titles with unsafe strings must now be redacted or replaced with a generic safe label before UI, errors, screenshots, diagnostics, logs, analytics, or committed evidence.
- [x] CHK030 Are requirements defined for mixed freshness when some selected sources are current and others are stale? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-047]
- [x] CHK031 Are requirements defined for all calendars being deselected after a source was previously connected? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK032 Are requirements defined for selected event-category preferences excluding every upcoming event? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-034]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK033 Are accessibility requirements written for keyboard reachability, focus visibility, screen-reader labels, live/progress states, and binary control states? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-026, Spec §US10]
- [x] CHK034 Are performance requirements clear enough to prevent provider network calls during initial settings state assembly and to keep manual sync feedback interactive? [Non-Functional, Plan §Performance Goals]
  - Resolution: manual sync request feedback now has a 2-second accepted/already-running/error threshold under normal server conditions and must not wait for provider sync completion.
- [x] CHK035 Are localization requirements clear that all user-facing calendar settings copy, labels, errors, confirmations, and helper text are in simple Russian? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK036 Are security/privacy requirements aligned with the constitution's visible consent and secret discipline principles? [Non-Functional, Constitution §II, Constitution §III, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-009]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK037 Are dependencies on Feature 060 calendar backend capabilities documented without requiring new provider adapters or calendar mutation behavior in 063? [Dependency, Plan §Storage, Plan §Structure Decision]
- [x] CHK038 Are assumptions about server-owned credentials, selected calendars, upcoming events, reminders, and recording-to-event context explicitly documented? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK039 Are out-of-scope boundaries complete for summary sending, attendee grants, calendar mutation, bot auto-join, retrospective matching, and real auto-record? [Coverage, Spec §Out of Scope, Plan §Constraints]
- [x] CHK040 Are validation-lane requirements documented for high-risk UX/privacy work before implementation begins? [Dependency, Plan §Risk / Validation Lane, Tasks §Risk / Validation Lane]
